item.title: Chile banks face backlash after new account maintenance fees
item.description: Consumers are complaining that new maintenance fees are quietly reducing disposable income and forcing families to rethink monthly budgets.

item.title: Viral TikTok challenge in Chile shows how families cut grocery spending
item.description: The trend spread quickly on social media after users posted side-by-side receipts showing how inflation changed weekly shopping habits.

item.title: Tax reform debate reignites fears over take-home pay in Chile
item.description: Workers and small business owners say they are worried that any new tax burden will immediately hit salaries and cash flow.

item.title: Corruption probe into regional housing fund triggers anger over lost savings
item.description: The scandal revived fears that ordinary people keep paying while institutions mishandle money intended to support households.
